description: The bar chart illustrates the performance gain (+%) of three different language models when subjected to strong supervision. The vertical axis represents the performance gain, measured in percentage, and the horizontal axis lists the names of the language models: GPT-4o, Claude-3.5-Sonnet, and Qwen2-72B-VL. The performance gain for GPT-4o is the highest, reaching approximately 25%, followed by Qwen2-72B-VL with a gain of around 15%, and Claude-3.5-Sonnet with the lowest gain, close to 5%. The bars are uniformly colored in a shade of blue, and the chart does not indicate any specific sorting or emphasis on any of the bars.
